description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “Makin’ Memories”, a beautiful 4-suite retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach. Steps from the famous Lagoon Pool and with a complimentary seasonal tram to the beach, every moment is designed for relaxation and connection. Enjoy the rare luxury of a brand-new private 1st-floor deck tucked among the trees and accessible from the primary king suite, creating a peaceful outdoor retreat that's hard to find in Seacrest Beach. With 6 beach cruiser bikes, spacious balconies and a 3rd-floor poker room with wet bar, this pet-friendly getaway is perfect for families and groups looking to create lasting memories along 30A. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Seacrest Beach Location: Just a 3-minute walk to the iconic 12,000 sq ft Lagoon Pool and a complimentary seasonal tram ride to the beachEnhanced Outdoor Living: Rare private 1st-floor deck nestled among the trees and accessible from the primary king suite, plus a spacious 3rd-floor deck for outdoor dining and entertainingSleeps 12 Comfortably: Four spacious suites spread across three levels, offering plenty of room for families and groupsEntertainment Lounge: Dedicated 3rd-floor poker room with a professional poker table, wet bar and outdoor lounge spaceExplore 30A with Ease: 6 beach cruiser bikes included for adventures to Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and nearby attractionsPet-Friendly Retreat: Bring your four-legged family member along for the vacationDesigned for Gathering: Open-concept living spaces and a well-appointed kitchen create the perfect setting for making memories togetherWalkable to Local Favorites: Minutes from Peddler's Pavilion, shopping, dining, live music and entertainment*** LIVING AREAS ***Designed for both relaxation and connection, “Makin' Memories” offers inviting spaces to gather throughout the home. The open-concept layout creates a welcoming atmosphere for family time, while the brand-new private deck with cozy seating and wooded views provides a peaceful outdoor retreat. Additional entertainment spaces offer room to spread out and unwind after a day at the beach.Open-concept living, dining and kitchen area designed for effortless gatheringComfortable seating and large flat-screen TV for movie nights and relaxationBrand-new private side deck with cozy seating and peaceful wooded views, accessible from the primary king suite and laundry roomEntertainment area featuring a professional poker table, wet bar and lounge spaceCovered deck with outdoor dining, comfortable seating and a gas fire table*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Whether you're preparing a family breakfast before heading to the beach or gathering for dinner after a day by the pool, the well-appointed kitchen offers everything needed to cook, connect and entertain with ease. Enjoy meals around the dining table, casual conversations at the breakfast bar or take dinner outdoors and dine beneath the trees on the brand-new private deck.Stainless steel appliances and ample counter space for effortless meal preparationBreakfast bar seating for 3Dining table with seating for 6Gas grill for cookouts and easy outdoor entertainingBrand-new private deck with outdoor dining, perfect for al fresco meals and relaxing evenings outdoors*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With four spacious suites spread across three levels, “Makin’ Memories” comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests while offering privacy and flexibility for families and groups.1st FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, direct access to the brand-new private deck with cozy seating & wooded views and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower2nd FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony and En-suite with dual vanities, walk-in shower and soaking tub3rd FloorKing Family Suite: King bed, two twin bunk beds, flat-screen TV, private balcony and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR SPACES ***From peaceful mornings on the brand-new private deck tucked among the trees to evenings gathered around the fire table, the outdoor spaces at “Makin’ Memories” offer the perfect setting to enjoy the beauty of 30A. With multiple balconies and deck spaces throughout the home, including a rare 1st-floor retreat accessible from the primary king suite, there’s always a place to relax, reconnect and take in the peaceful wooded surroundings.Brand-new private 1st-floor deck with cozy seating and wooded viewsMultiple balcony spaces throughout all three levels of the homeCovered 3rd-floor deck with outdoor dining and lounge seatingGas fire table for relaxing evenings outdoorsEasy access to scenic community boardwalks and walking trails*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Situated in the heart of Seacrest Beach between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, “Makin’ Memories” offers easy access to some of the most sought-after destinations along 30A.Lagoon Pool: 12,000 sq ft resort-style pool with waterfalls, lounging areas and zero-entry designSeasonal Beach Tram: Convenient transportation to and from the beachPeddler’s Pavilion: Walk to dining, shopping, live music and seasonal entertainmentRosemary Beach: Stroll charming cobblestone streets lined with boutiques and cafésAlys Beach: Explore stunning white architecture and beautiful green spacesScenic walking paths and nature trails throughout the communitySouth Walton's tallest sand dunes just moments away*** PET FRIENDLY ***Non shedding, housebroken dogs onlyPets are not allowed on furniture or bedsMust be kept in a crate when guests are not with their dogWith non-refundable pet fee $250 + tax*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to access the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest or Alys BeachActive Ring doorbell camera located at the front entrance*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we're committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and unforgettable coastal memories.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 30376STRO #: STR-030376 Read less
